settings.profile.title: Profile
settings.profile.name: Name
settings.profile.usernameHint: Latin letters, digits and "_". People can find you and invite you to chats by it.
settings.profile.linkHint: Send this link to your family — it opens your profile in SkyMessage right away.
settings.phone.title: Phone number
settings.phone.noneText: Add your number so your family can find you from their phone book. The number is not verified by SMS.
settings.phone.linkedHint: Your number only helps people who know you find you. You choose below who can see it.
settings.phone.unlinkText: People will no longer find you by this number. Your messages and contacts stay.
settings.phone.detect.title: From the SIM card
settings.phone.detect.hint: Your phone suggests the number of its SIM card. With two SIM cards, pick the one you want.
settings.phone.detect.notFound: Could not detect the number — please enter it manually
settings.phone.detect.deniedTitle: No access to the phone number
settings.phone.detect.denied: Allow SkyMessage to read the phone number in the device settings, or enter the number manually.
settings.phone.manual.title: Enter a number
settings.phone.allowFind: Let people find me by this number
settings.phone.replaceText: Your current number is {0}. Replace it with the new one?
settings.phone.findBy.title: Who can find me by my number
settings.phone.findBy.hint: When your family imports their phone book, SkyMessage suggests your account to them.
settings.phone.show.title: Who can see my number
settings.phone.show.hint: Only these people see the number in your profile.
settings.privacy.title: Privacy
settings.privacy.whoHint: Blocked people see nothing about you, whatever is chosen here.
settings.privacy.lastSeen.hint: Others only see an approximate time such as "recently" or "within a week".
settings.privacy.photo.hint: Others see your initials instead of the photo.
settings.privacy.phone.hint: Only the chosen people see the number in your profile.
settings.privacy.findByPhone.hint: Who gets your account suggested when your number is in their phone book.
settings.privacy.messages.hint: Someone you already chatted with can keep writing to you.
settings.privacy.calls.hint: Others will not be able to call you.
settings.privacy.groups.hint: Others can only invite you with an invite link.
settings.blocked.title: Blocked people
settings.blocked.noneText: Blocked people cannot message or call you or see when you are online.
settings.blocked.hint: They cannot message or call you, see your photo or when you were online.
settings.blocked.confirmText: They will not be able to message or call you. They will not be told.
settings.sessions.title: Devices
settings.sessions.onlyThis: Your account is only open on this device.
settings.sessions.tapHint: Tap a device to sign it out of your account.
settings.sessions.terminateText: "{0}" will have to sign in again.
settings.sessions.terminated: Done, the device is signed out
settings.sessions.terminateAllHint: Useful if you signed in on someone else's phone or computer.
settings.sessions.terminateAllText: Only this device stays signed in. The others will have to sign in again.
settings.sessions.terminatedAll: All other devices are signed out
settings.password.title: Password
settings.password.subtitle: Change your account password
settings.deleteAccount.title: Delete account
settings.deleteAccount.text: This cannot be undone. Think again — maybe signing out is enough?
settings.deleteAccount.point.profile: Your name, photo, number and username will be deleted.
settings.deleteAccount.point.messages: Your messages stay with the people you wrote to, signed as "Deleted Account".
settings.deleteAccount.point.devices: Every device will be signed out.
settings.deleteAccount.understand: I understand the account cannot be restored
settings.notifications.title: Notifications and sounds
settings.notifications.blockedText: Allow notifications for SkyMessage in the device settings, or you will not know about new messages and calls.
settings.notifications.blockedTextWeb: Allow notifications for this site: click the lock icon in the browser's address bar.
settings.notifications.askText: So you do not miss messages and calls.
settings.notifications.iosHint: On iPhone, messages and calls arrive while SkyMessage is open. Notifications for the closed app will come in a future update.
settings.notifications.webHint: In the browser, messages and calls arrive while the SkyMessage tab is open. To never miss a call, install the app on your phone.
settings.notifications.enabledHint: When the app is in the background or another chat is open
settings.notifications.previewHint: When off, only the sender is shown
settings.notifications.mentionsHint: Notify even when a chat is muted
settings.notifications.packHint: Messages, calls and call tones share one style. Every sound is made just for SkyMessage.
settings.notifications.customPickHint.me: An MP3, M4A, OGG or WAV file, up to 10 seconds
settings.notifications.customPickHint.ri: An MP3, M4A, OGG or WAV file, up to a minute
settings.notifications.customRemoveText: The sound from the “{0}” set will play instead.
settings.notifications.customHint: Your own sound is kept on this device only.
settings.notifications.customAppleHint: System notifications on iPhone and Mac play the set's sound.
settings.notifications.customError.forma: This file won't do: choose an MP3, M4A, OGG or WAV sound.
settings.notifications.customError.tooLa: The file is larger than {0} MB. Choose a shorter sound.
settings.notifications.customError.unrea: This file can't be played. Try another one.
settings.notifications.customError.tooLo: A message sound can be up to 10 seconds long.
The ringtone is longer than a minute. Choose a shorter part.
settings.notifications.customError.syste: Android on this phone can't play this kind of file in notifications. Choose an MP3 or M4A.
settings.notifications.callsHint: Ring and show the call full screen
settings.notifications.backgroundHint: Until push notifications arrive, this is the only way to get calls and messages while the app is closed. A small permanent notification stays in the notification shade.
settings.notifications.keepConnectedHint: Calls and messages arrive even when SkyMessage is closed
settings.notifications.battery: Do not restrict in the background
settings.notifications.batteryHint: Allow running without battery optimization, or the phone may cut the connection after a few minutes
settings.notifications.batteryDone: Done: the phone will not stop SkyMessage
settings.appearance.title: Appearance
settings.appearance.preview.name: Mom
settings.appearance.preview.in: How is the weather there? We baked pies today 🥧
settings.appearance.preview.out: Warm and sunny ☀️ I will call you soon!
settings.appearance.customInvalid: Enter a color as #RRGGBB, for example #6C5CE7
settings.appearance.wallpaperHint: The sky behind every screen and chat. At night, stars come out on it.
settings.appearance.animationsHint: Smooth transitions between screens. Turn off if the phone feels slow
settings.appearance.compactHint: More chats on screen, without the second line
settings.appearance.resetText: Theme, color, background, text size and corners go back to how they were after installing.
settings.chats.title: Chats
settings.chats.sendByEnterOff: Enter adds a new line, send with the button
settings.chats.autoplayVideosHint: Muted, while you scroll the chat
settings.chats.autoplayNotesHint: Round videos start muted when they are on screen
settings.chats.voiceSpeedHint: The speed voice messages start with. You can also change it right in the chat.
settings.devices.title: Sound and video
settings.devices.unavailable: Microphone and camera are not available
settings.devices.unavailableText: This device or browser gives no access to the microphone and camera.
settings.devices.insecure: Browsers only allow the microphone and camera on secure pages (https). Open SkyMessage at an address that starts with https://.
settings.devices.denied: No access to the microphone or camera
settings.devices.deniedText: Allow SkyMessage to use the microphone and camera in the device settings — calls will not work otherwise.
settings.devices.deniedTextWeb: Allow the microphone and camera for this site: click the lock icon in the browser's address bar.
settings.devices.accessText: Then the names of your microphones, cameras and speakers appear here.
settings.devices.micHint: Say something — the bar should move. Record a couple of phrases and hear how others hear you.
settings.devices.processingHint: Echo and noise suppression make your voice clearer. Turn them off only if your voice sounds distorted.
settings.devices.mirrorHint: Only for you — others see the picture as it is
settings.devices.speaker: Speakers
settings.devices.speakerSystem: Sound plays on the device chosen in the system.
settings.devices.routeHint: Where sound goes when a call starts. Connected headphones always win, and you can switch during the call.
settings.devices.route.autoHint: Voice calls to the phone speaker, video calls to the loudspeaker
settings.devices.pauseMusic: Pause music while recording and in calls
settings.devices.pauseMusicHint: Music and videos in other apps go quiet during a call or while you record a voice or video message, then play on
settings.devices.qualityHint: Higher quality needs more internet. On a weak connection the quality drops by itself.
settings.devices.error.none: Device not found — check that it is connected
settings.devices.error.busy: The device is busy in another program
settings.devices.error.failed: Could not turn the device on
settings.data.title: Data and storage
settings.data.nowMobile: You are on mobile data now.
settings.data.qualityHint: To send the original without compression, choose "Send without compression" in the chat.
settings.data.photo.low: Up to 1280 pixels — faster and cheaper
settings.data.galleryHint: Photos and videos you save go to the phone's gallery
settings.data.lowDataHint: Calls and pictures in lower quality — for expensive or slow internet
settings.data.storageHint: Downloaded photos, videos and files are kept on the server — after clearing you can download them again.
settings.data.clearText: Photos, videos and files are removed from this device but stay in the chats — you can download them again.
settings.data.browserCache: In the browser, downloaded files are kept by the browser itself. You can clear them in the browser settings.
settings.language.title: Language
settings.language.autoHint: Russian when the device is in Russian or its language is unknown
settings.language.hint: The app language changes right away. Messages are not translated.
settings.connection.title: Connection
settings.connection.test: Test the connection to the server
settings.connection.serverHint: The address of your SkyMessage server. Only change it if the person who set it up told you to.
settings.connection.fallbacksHint: If the main address is unreachable, the app tries the fallbacks by itself. It only connects to the same server — this is verified.
settings.connection.addFallbackText: Another address of the same server, for example a spare domain.
settings.connection.invalidAddress: Enter an address, for example chat.example.com
settings.connection.alreadyAdded: This address is already in the list
settings.connection.fallbackUnreachable: This address does not answer right now — it will help once it works
settings.connection.fallbackOther: A different server answers at this address — the app will not connect to it
settings.connection.transportHint: If WebSocket is blocked on the network, the app switches to slower but more reliable channels.
settings.connection.proxyNote: The proxy applies to messages and media; calls may not work through a proxy.
settings.connection.proxyOk: The server answers through this proxy
settings.connection.proxyFailed: The server does not answer through this proxy
settings.server.hint: You get the address from whoever set up the server. If it is a different SkyMessage server, you will be signed out of this account.
settings.server.notFoundSave: No server answers at this address. Check it, or press "Save" again to use it anyway.
settings.server.otherServer: This is a different SkyMessage server. You will be signed out on this device and sign in there.
settings.about.title: About
settings.about.licensesHint: SkyMessage is built on open components. Here are their licenses and authors.
settings.about.own: Icons by Lucide. Sounds, backgrounds and the logo are made for SkyMessage.
settings.licenses.unavailable: The license text did not load. Please try again.
settings.licenses.apps: Used in the Android, iPhone and Mac apps.
settings.licenses.playServices: Google Play services suggest the SIM card number on Android. They are free and provided under Google's terms.
settings.licenses.livekit: The library for voice and video calls.
